AnyonyaAbhava.Anyonya: {ℓt : Level} {T : Type ℓt} → T → T → Type ℓt
AnyonyaAbhava.anyonya-is-abhava:
{ℓt : Level} {T : Type ℓt} (a b : T) →
Anyonya a b → Abhāva T (_≡ b)
AnyonyaAbhava.anyonya-from-abhava:
{ℓt : Level} {T : Type ℓt} (a : T) (A : Abhāva T (_≡ a)) →
Anyonya (delimitor A) a
AnyonyaAbhava.anyonya→samsarga:
{ℓx = ℓt : Level} {ℓy = T : Level} {ℓt = a : Level}
{X = b : Type ℓt} {Y = A : Type T} {T = T₁ : Type a} (q : b → A)
(t : b → T₁) {x x' : b} →
q x ≡ q x' → Anyonya (t x) (t x') → ¬ FactorsThrough q t
AnyonyaAbhava.samsarga→¬¬anyonya:
{ℓx = ℓt : Level} {ℓy = T : Level} {ℓt = a : Level}
{X = b : Type ℓt} {Y = A : Type T} {T = T₁ : Type a} →
Discrete T₁ →
(q : b → A) (t : b → T₁) →
¬ FactorsThrough q t → ¬ (¬ Collision q t)
AnyonyaAbhava.samsarga→anyonya-when-decidable:
{ℓx = ℓt : Level} {ℓy = T : Level} {ℓt = a : Level}
{X = b : Type ℓt} {Y = A : Type T} {T = T₁ : Type a} →
Discrete T₁ →
(q : b → A) (t : b → T₁) →
Dec (Collision q t) → ¬ FactorsThrough q t → Collision q t
AnyonyaAbhava.categories-agree-when-decidable:
{ℓx = ℓt : Level} {ℓy = T : Level} {ℓt = a : Level}
{X = b : Type ℓt} {Y = A : Type T} {T = T₁ : Type a} →
Discrete T₁ →
(q : b → A) (t : b → T₁) →
Dec (Collision q t) →
(Collision q t → ¬ FactorsThrough q t) ×
(¬ FactorsThrough q t → Collision q t)
